title: 07章、全民功法长春册
content_zh:
小屋外的空间开始出现破裂，出现了宛如鱼鳞一般的裂纹，时不时有一片掉落下来，化为乌有，透过暴露出来的缝隙，隐约可以看见外界的一片狼藉。

    相对比外界的浓烟滚滚一片废墟，听着断断续续的哭喊声、呼唤声、爆炸声，这里就像是一片与世隔绝的世外桃源一般。

    看着窗外天空之上的斑驳裂痕，张荼虽然不明白又强行给了他什么，但是他清楚，边关月口中的抉择，自己怕是要尽快做出决定。

    “就在我家附近的夷水畔！”

    对于打小生活在夷水畔的张荼而言，这一条静静流淌千年的河流，有着不一样的感情。

    边关月露出了然的神情，说道：“一切如你所愿，当然还有一个选择，需要你自己来做决定。”

    但是紧接着，边关月说出了一个让他近乎难以抉择的决定。

    边关月指了指自己，说道：“这个是关于我的存在，有两个选择，一个选择我以灵魂的方式，寄居在你的身体之上，就是如同你所看到的那些老爷爷一般，指导你，教导你，甚至是……保护你。如你所想，逆袭人生的标准开局。”

    “当然而另外一个选择呢，则是我成为一个独立的个体，你我都是独立的个体。你觉得呢？你打算选哪个？同样的时间不多。请做出你的选择。”

    张荼闻言不禁眉头蹙起，他心下了然，若是边关月以灵魂的方式寄居在自己身上，那对自己的好处显而易见，不仅可以让自己少走歪路同时可以因材施教，他绝对不相信一个废物会被选中在这里等着自己。

    所谓最大的宝藏，怕不是就是边关月他自己吧。

    但是坏处同样显而易见，对于张荼而言，无异于身上二十四小时装了一个不需要耗电的摄像头，对于一个极度缺乏安全感和隐私保护欲的人来说，这无疑是一种致命的伤害。

    但同样的，有着边关月的随身，自己会少走多少弯路，那是显而易见，当有一个历经沧海桑田的智者作为自己的人生导航。

    张荼太明白里面所隐性蕴含的财富了，那是一股无法衡量的财富，更别说，在自己成长期有这么一位为自己保驾护航，自己有着更大的机会登临绝巅。

    毕竟，王腾的教训可是历历在目。

    张荼的眉头仅仅蹙起，似是一时难以决定，但随即看到了边关月那故作轻松的面庞，严肃地说道：“我选择……”

    “第二个！”

    做出决定的时候，两个人都是露出了如释重负的表情，不约笑了起来，将杯中的茶水一抿而尽，那豪迈的姿态，在边关月身上竟是说不出的肆意风流。

    对于张荼而言，他自己都很不适应有人依附自己身上，更何况依附的人呢？相对比之下，依附之人的感觉岂不是更糟糕？

    生命诚可贵，爱情价更高，若为自由故，二者皆可抛。

    己所不欲勿施于人。

    再说了，眼前的边关月明显是有着肉体，到时候还要为他重塑肉身，多麻烦呐。

    而且他虽说不是至高的圣人，但内心深处有着自己的坚守。

    若是说对敌，腹黑也好，不择手段也罢，那都说得过去，可是面对一个对自己提供帮助的人，张荼没有理由说去做出一个仅仅有利于自己的选择。

    半晌，边关月面色凝重地说了一声：“谢谢。”
content_en:
The space outside the hut began to crack, with cracks like fish scales appearing. From time to time, a piece fell off and turned into nothing. Through the exposed gaps, the mess of the outside world could be vaguely seen.

    Compared with the smoke and ruins outside, and the intermittent cries, calls, and explosions, this place feels like an isolated paradise.

    Looking at the mottled cracks in the sky outside the window, Zhang Tu didn't understand what was being forced on him, but he knew that he was afraid that he would have to make a decision as soon as possible due to the choice Bian Guanyue said.

    "It's right by the Yishui River near my home!"

    For Zhang Tu, who has lived by the Yi River since childhood, this river that has been flowing quietly for thousands of years has different emotions.

    Bian Guanyue showed a clear look and said: "Everything is as you wish. Of course, there is another choice. You need to make your own decision."

    But then, Bian Guanyue made a decision that made it almost difficult for him to make a decision.

    Bian Guanyue pointed at herself and said: "This is about my existence. There are two choices. One choice is for me to live in your body as a soul, just like the old grandfathers you have seen, guiding you, teaching you, and even...protecting you. As you think, it is a standard start for counterattack in life."

    "Of course, the other option is for me to become an independent individual, and you and I are both independent individuals. What do you think? Which one are you going to choose? There is not much time for the same. Please make your choice."

    Zhang Tu couldn't help but frown when he heard this. He understood in his mind that if Bian Guanyue lived in him as a soul, the benefits to him would be obvious. Not only would he avoid going astray, but he would also be able to teach students according to their aptitude. He absolutely did not believe that a loser would be chosen to wait for him here.

    The so-called greatest treasure is probably Bian Guanyue himself.

    But the disadvantages are also obvious. For Zhang Tu, it is like having a camera installed on his body 24 hours a day that does not require power consumption. For a person who is extremely insecure and has a desire for privacy protection, this is undoubtedly a fatal injury.

    But in the same way, with Bian Guanyue by my side, I will take fewer detours. It is obvious that when I have a wise man who has experienced the vicissitudes of life as my life navigation.

    Zhang Tu is very aware of the hidden wealth contained in it. It is an immeasurable wealth, not to mention that with such a person protecting him during his growth period, he has a greater chance of reaching the top.

    After all, Wang Teng’s lessons are still fresh in his mind.

    Zhang Tu's brows just furrowed, as if he couldn't decide for a moment, but then he saw Bian Guanyue's pretending to be relaxed face, and said seriously: "I choose..."

    "The second one!"

    When they made the decision, both of them showed expressions of relief. They laughed and drank all the tea in the cup. That heroic gesture was indescribably wanton and romantic on Bian Guanyue.

    For Zhang Tu, he himself is not used to having people attached to him, let alone the people who are attached to him? In comparison, wouldn’t the dependent person feel worse?

    Life is truly precious, but love is even more valuable. If it is for freedom, both can be thrown away.

    Don't do to others what you don't want others to do to you.

    Besides, the Bian Guanyue in front of me obviously has a physical body. It will be very troublesome to reshape his physical body when the time comes.

    And although he is not the supreme saint, he has his own persistence deep in his heart.

    If you are talking about facing an enemy, being shady or doing whatever it takes, that is all justified, but when facing someone who helps him, Zhang Tu has no reason to make a choice that is only beneficial to himself.

    After a while, Bian Guanyue said solemnly: "Thank you."
